title: DevExp Sprint Scrapbook — Week of 2026-10-19
content:
DevExp Sprint Scrapbook — Week of Oct 19, 2026
Owner: Asha Patel
Attendees: Marcus, Sofia, Rajiv, Evelyn, Tom (and quick check-ins from product/hosted-api)

Purpose: informal capture of standup notes, mini-decisions, and small / half-done TODOs that we don’t want to lose. This file intentionally contains rough items, pointers to PRs/issues, and concrete next steps.

---

A) Quick wins / things shipped this week
- Quickstart: added Node + Python templates for function-calling example (playground-samples). Local dev flow validated by Marcus — see GH PR #842.
- Docs: streaming-response guide expanded with troubleshooting steps for SSE chunks and SDK backpressure. Logged on Confluence page.
- Samples: tiny todo app updated to demonstrate prefix caching (config sample + trace).

B) Current focus areas
1) SDK release candidate for 1.8.0 (target: 2026-10-26)
   - Major items: improved retry semantics, streaming cancel hook, simplified credentials flow for Dedicated customers.
   - Blocking: intermittent CI flakiness on macOS wheels (failing wheel build step). Marcus investigating, root cause likely related to new buildx cache.
   - PRs to watch: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842 (templates), /PR/855 (retry change, Jeff listed in PR), /PR/864 (streaming cancel API).

2) Quickstarts / onboarding path
   - Goal: reduce time-to-first-output for new users to under 5 minutes on hosted API.
   - Observed friction: default API keys in quickstart spinner sometimes hit rate-limit quota for new orgs. Short-term mitigation: add a link to credit top-up and an example curl with reduced concurrency.
   - Action: Sofia to add a small note in quickstart README and add telemetry event (quickstart_started) for metrics team to instrument.

3) Samples sandbox stability
   - Several sample apps losing socket connection when using streaming + tool-calls combination. Repro case recorded in RDW-2137.
   - Temporary workaround: retry logic and user-visible message in sample app UI. Rajiv to push patch to sample repo by EOD Wed.

C) Meeting notes / discussion highlights
- Streaming cancellation semantics: we decided to expose an explicit cancel() on the streaming iterator across SDKs to make it clear for mobile and browser clients. Need docs for best practices (examples in JS/Swift).
- Prefix caching demo: Evelyn ran the demo with a 30% token reduction across 3 synthetic flows. We should capture numbers in a short note for Optimize team. Evelyn to write a 1-page memo with measured throughput/cost delta.
- Quickstart templates: keep minimal but swap to use token-aware prompts in the advanced template (so users see a quality/cost tradeoff). Marcus to update node template.

D) Decisions made
- Defer the breaking change that renames `createClient` -> `initClient` (will be an opt-in experimental alias) to avoid churn in 1.8.0. Decision: add deprecation warning in logs, stable rename in 1.9.0.
- Canary rollout policy for samples: enable canary flag for 10% of orgs for the new sample that demos private deployment config. Rollout controlled via console flags. Tom to coordinate with product to set flag by next Tuesday.

E) Action items (owner - due date - status)
- Marcus Liu — Fix macOS wheel CI flake and publish RC wheel artifacts — due 2026-10-22 — in_progress
- Sofia Nguyen — Update quickstart README and add telemetry event — due 2026-10-21 — todo
- Rajiv Menon — Patch sample app retry handling for streaming/tool-calls (RDW-2137) — due 2026-10-21 — in_progress
- Evelyn Garcia — Short memo: prefix cache benchmark + numbers + sample config — due 2026-10-25 — todo
- Tom Becker — Coordinate canary flag configuration with product + set rollout to 10% — due 2026-10-26 — todo
- Asha Patel — Compile RC checklist and run a docs smoke test (links, examples) — due 2026-10-23 — todo

F) Blockers / risks
- CI flake blocks packaging of wheels -> delays for pip users (medium risk).
- Rate-limit exposure in quickstart may cause confusing first-run experience for small orgs (low-medium risk).
- Samples sandbox host has intermittent 502s when concurrent streams spike; Ops ticket opened and tagged SRE.

G) Parking lot (not for this sprint unless capacity)
- Rewrite quickstarts to include a one-click deploy button for GitHub Codespaces / Cloud Shell (nice-to-have).
- Consider a “micro-FAQ” in the quickstart README listing common first-run errors and how to resolve them (copyable commands).

H) Notes to self / unresolved questions
- How soon do we want to surface the cost estimator in the quickstart? Should it be a link or an inline widget? (Product decision)
- Need a quick dev flow for Dedicated customers who require mutual TLS; current sample uses API key only. Rajiv to sketch a minimal mTLS example and propose layout.

I) Useful links captured here
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842
- Tickets: JIRA RDW-2137 (streaming + tool-calls repro), RDW-2172 (macOS wheel build flake)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVEXP/Quickstart+Playbook

---
End of scrapbook snapshot. Will keep iterating on this weekly; next edit will include pre/post-rc metrics and any user-reported onboarding improvements.

Notes: raw, half-formed items deliberately left in — this is a working doc.
